stanza: Walking through your garden
Pulling up the garlic
Getting our hands dirty
Kissing on the vampires
Kissing on the werewolves
We have no enemies

q.line: Fragile orange wind in the garden
stanza: Orange is the color of my love
Fragile orange wind in the garden
Fragile means that I can hear her flesh
Crying little rivers in her forearm
Fragile is that I mourn her death
As our limbs are twisting in her bedroom

partner.line: Crying little rivers in her forearm

q.line: I'm planting myself in the garden
stanza: I'm planting myself in the garden
Believe me
Between the potatoes and parsley
Believe me

q.line: And we got to get ourselves back to the garden
stanza: We are stardust
Billion year old carbon
We are golden
Caught in the devil's bargain
And we got to get ourselves back to the garden
All the ladies of the canyon
Wearing white for their tea parties
Playing games of levitation
Meditating in the garden

partner.line: Wearing white for their tea parties

q.line: Or lead me to the garden?
stanza: But if I just showed up at your party
Would you have me? Would you want me?
Would you tell me to go fuck myself
Or lead me to the garden?
In the garden, would you trust me
If I told you it was just a summer thing?
I'm only seventeen, I don't know anything
But I know I miss you

partner.line: But if I just showed up at your party

q.line: Drove the car into the garden?
stanza: Remember when you lost your shit and
Drove the car into the garden?
You got out and said "I'm sorry"
To the vines and no one saw it

partner.line: You got out and said "I'm sorry"

q.line: Enough money to let Max Gordon
stanza: When Missus Ned McLean (God bless her)
Can get Russian reds to "yes" her
Then I suppose
Anything goes
When Rockefeller still can hoard
Enough money to let Max Gordon
Produce his shows
Anything goes
